admission.justification: Candidate-only equality or joining two real cards would let one judgment hide a distinct before-state or card obligation. Complete B/C equality and retained per-source blobs let exact cardless copies share work without losing provenance or reopening behavior.

applicability: Native unexplained-change generation for uncovered paths in one paired base/candidate code comparison.
conditions: Group by the complete pair of base and candidate blob identities, not candidate-only equality; absent sides retain their absence identity.
Only uncovered paths enter grouping; paths absent on both sides supply no identical blob pair.
Choose the first card-bearing path when any exists, otherwise the first sorted path; additional card-bearing paths keep their own obligations.
Cardless equals join that representative and the caller retains every grouped candidate and base blob for source-bound judgment currentness.
exclusions: Generated-copy equality is a separate declared/candidate-aware predicate, not a substitute for this two-sided uncovered grouping.
No similarity/content inference, coverage reclassification or permission to omit a distinct card-bearing path, and no execution or timing grade.
statement: Uncovered identical B-to-C changes share one representative judgment with every grouped candidate blob, while two card-bearing paths and covered paths retain separate obligations.
